## Experience
- Full-Stack Generative AI Developer, Neural Arc Inc, Pune (Sep 2026 to present): built the LLM routing engine (selects models by task type, semantic similarity, context, latency, token efficiency); built BYOK infrastructure for user API keys across 8 LLM providers with per-tenant isolation; built workflow systems connecting AI agents, APIs, models, auth and backends.
- Full-Stack Generative AI Developer Intern, Neural Arc Inc (Jun to Sep 2026): built a multi-agent system with Python, LLMs, RAG, tool calling and orchestration, reaching 90% task success on an internal eval set; cut production incidents by 80%.
- AI & ML Intern, Gradence Global, remote UK (Nov 2025 to May 2026): built and deployed an automated B2B lead-gen and outreach system (Python, Flask, Selenium, Gmail OAuth2, Google Sheets API, Groq Llama 3.3-70B); 68% reply rate on 100 leads, 20 hours per week saved.
- Data Science Intern, Anyatam Adhyayan Education Services, Pune (Jan to Apr 2025): built Healthify, a diabetes prediction app (best model 84% accuracy), deployed on Render.

## Projects
- [Meridian](https://github.com/psyphon1/Meridian): autonomous AI pull request reviewer; pre-alpha (design, documentation, scaffolding and CI complete, implementation under way).
- [Aura-Therapist](https://huggingface.co/psyphon1/Llama-2-7b-Therapist-Aura-Full): Llama-2-7B-chat fine-tuned with QLoRA (r=32, alpha=16) on 2K instruction pairs; runs on 6 GB VRAM with 4-bit NF4.
- [PageMindAI](https://github.com/psyphon1/PageMindAI): Chrome extension (Manifest V3) with a FastAPI RAG backend; Llama 3.3-70B on Groq, FAISS, FastEmbed, LangChain.
- [Deep Research Multi-Agent System](https://github.com/psyphon1/Deep-Research-Multi-Agent-System): LangChain and Groq agents that search the web, write a report and have a critic agent score it; [live app](https://deep-research-psyphon-agent.streamlit.app/).
- [AI Lead Agent](https://github.com/psyphon1/AI_Lead_Agent): automated B2B outreach; [live](https://leadgenog.vercel.app/).
- [ATS Resume Analyzer](https://github.com/psyphon1/Ats-resume-analyzer): resume parsing with RAG-based candidate search.
- [Healthify](https://github.com/psyphon1/healthify-1.0): diabetes prediction; [live](https://healthify-yzfn.onrender.com/).
- [MovieMatch](https://github.com/psyphon1/Movie-Recommendation-System-1.0): content-based movie recommender (TF-IDF, cosine similarity); [live](https://movie-recommendation-system-1-0.vercel.app/).
